summary: Inter & Co filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of an 8-K current report for foreign private issuers) disclosing a senior leadership structure evolution. Francisco Santos, ex-CEO of Midway/Guararapes, is expected to join as SVP Chief Growth Officer, while Alexandre Riccio moves from CEO Brazil to SVP Chief Operating Officer and is appointed Executive Vice Chairman of the Board, joining Rubens Menin and Joao Vitor Menin. Implementation is subject to required approvals, after which SVP roles become Banco Inter S.A.'s highest-ranking executive positions. No transaction terms, advisors, or shareholder vote are disclosed; watch for approval timing and any further C-suite turnover.
